highlights.title: River journeys
highlights.text: Three to fourteen days on the Rio Negro. Dawn mist. Night sounds.

highlights.title: Canopy walks
highlights.text: Walk the green cathedral. Look down on a world that never sleeps.

highlights.title: Wildlife photography
highlights.text: Patience rewarded. Pink dolphins. Toucans. The river at its quietest.
